'''S.I.G.M.A.''' is an [[NPC]] at {{Location|Startorch Academy - Freight Zone|nocat=1}} in [[Lahai-Roi]]. He is an automaton in charge of issuing [[Expedition Motorbike]]s and enforcing traffic rules. 

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}} 

==Idle==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''S.I.G.M.A.''' First, no quick thrills. Second, no slipping on traffic rules. Third, safety first, no exceptions!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} I'd like to have my Expedition Motorbike tweaked.
::'''S.I.G.M.A.:''' Guaranteed Safety. Guaranteed Compliant Modifications!
::'''S.I.G.M.A.:''' Any modification in violation of the regulations will not escape my notice.
:; (Opens Expedition Motorbike menu)
::'''S.I.G.M.A.:''' This is Signal Intelligent Guidance & Management Automaton S.I.G.M.A. wishing you a safe journey.
{{Dialogue End}}
